headline: Nasdaq 100 Slips as AI Leaders Urge a Slowdown, 10-Year Yield Touches 5%: Stock Market Today
summary: Security software surged on AI-safety warnings while optics and chip-test names cratered, as the 10-year yield briefly topped 5% and oil pushed past $102.

headline: Billionaire Investor Adds To ASML, Exits Rivals KLA and Lam — Plus Nvidia, Broadcom
summary: Dan Loeb’s Third Point more than doubled its ASML stake to 30,000 shares in the second quarter while exiting NVIDIA, Broadcom, KLA and Lam Research.
